name: glitchit
description: GlitchIt — Android APK social marketplace app

scripts.apk:sync: node build.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:build: node build.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node build.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
